title: Ali's Morning
text:
Ali wakes up at seven o'clock every day. First, he brushes his teeth and takes a shower. Then he eats breakfast with his family. He likes eggs and bread.

After breakfast, Ali walks to school. He goes to school at eight o'clock. School starts at half past eight. At four o'clock, Ali goes home and does his homework.

questions.text: What time does Ali wake up?

paragraph_translations: Ali her gün saat yedide uyanır. Önce dişlerini fırçalar ve duş alır. Sonra ailesiyle birlikte kahvaltı eder. Yumurta ve ekmek sever.
Kahvaltıdan sonra Ali okula yürür. Saat sekizde okula gider. Okul sekiz buçukta başlar. Saat dörtte Ali eve gider ve ev ödevini yapar.
